onboarding.livingkingdoms.title: A new beginning
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.welcome: Welcome to %s, traveler. These homes are more than shelter: they are a community. Before we ask for your help, let me tell you about the people who live here.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.people: Our farmers keep the stores supplied, builders turn materials into homes, and guards protect the roads. Talk to our neighbors: their needs will guide our first steps together.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.needs: We need food, tools and room for new families. Pillagers and the undead threaten travelers beyond our walls. The Quest Board holds real requests; helping it grow also means protecting this region.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.responsib: Are you sure you want to help? You will choose construction projects, provide supplies, organize workers and prepare our defenses. Requests and rewards are handled here, in person. We grow one step at a time.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.naming: Then let us begin. Choose a name for the kingdom we will build together. The village, its people and its land will remain the same. Use 1–32 letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.joining: %s already has a name and a community of helpers. Join us to share the work; the kingdom belongs to all its people. Its name and territory will stay as they are.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.help: I want to help this kingdom
onboarding.livingkingdoms.accept: Yes, you can count on me
